authority: presentation and falsification metadata only; nesting creates no identity, recognition, capability, system, governance, economic, or constitutional authority
purpose: Test whether the ten-station Vitae Tree and its registered twenty-two-path comparison graph can be co-rendered with the transported ARCnet stellar frame without collapsing internal curriculum navigation into outer system topology or Human/Identity semantics.

host_tests.reason: Vitae is an internal Arcanum curriculum/faculty coordinate. The Tree may therefore be rendered as a local Arcanum-owned navigation subframe while remaining a different node/edge registry.
Centering the Tree on Human/Identity would visually imply that symbolic/curriculum stations describe or partition the person, conflicting with Identity as continuity rather than description.
Ten Tree stations and eight ARCnet systems have different roles, counts, authority classes, and registries; no node-to-node mapping is justified.

tree_local_frame.host_behavior: The Arcanum outer vertex remains fixed in the local ARCnet frame. Tree station changes alter only active internal navigation state, not X_arcanum.

edge_firewall.arcnet_edge_meaning: cross-system semantic relation and possible future capability-scoped invocation boundary
edge_firewall.candidate_law: Internal Path Is Not Network Edge.

active_station_projection.allowed_effect: highlight the corresponding Tree station in the local Vitae subframe

transport_behavior.outer_transport: The complete ARCnet local frame may translate/rotate along the Tempus x Vitae presentation field.
transport_behavior.nested_transport: The Arcanum-local Vitae Tree inherits the outer frame transport as a passenger subframe plus its own presentation-only local orientation.
transport_behavior.relative_semantics: No outer semantic relation is created by visual proximity between a Tree station and an ARCnet vertex during projection.
transport_behavior.candidate_law: Nested Motion Is Not Nested Authority.

falsification_tests.pass: moving/highlighting Tree stations leaves Human/Identity center unchanged and non-descriptive
Arcanum remains one outer system while the Tree remains an internal local subframe
22 Tree paths never become ARCnet Edge Contracts
Tree state never changes capability or authority
outer transport moves the local Tree frame rigidly without changing its registry
Tree state and ARCnet state remain expressible as separate cards/lists without geometry

audit_disposition: BOUNDED_PASS only when hosted as an Arcanum-local Vitae subframe or detached inset; FAIL when centered on Identity or mapped onto outer ARCnet vertices.
